description: This file contains socket utility functions for server and client socket creation, connection, listening, setting keepalive options, and OVSDB socket connection management, including macros for array operations.

methods.name: server_socket_create
methods.description: Creates a server socket (TCP or UDP), binds it to the specified address and port, and sets socket options.

methods.name: client_socket_create
methods.description: Creates a client socket (TCP or UDP).

methods.name: client_connect
methods.description: Connects a client socket to a specified server IP and port.

methods.name: tcp_server_listen
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, close-on-exec, and starts listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: socket_set_keepalive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive with specific parameters on a socket.

methods.name: ovsdb_conn
methods.description: Establishes a UNIX domain socket connection to OVSDB at the specified socket path.
